q: 1. The pitch of CGI iron sheet is
explain: Corrugated Galvanised Iron (CGI) sheets have a standard corrugation pitch (centre-to-centre distance of corrugations) of about 3 inches.

q: 2. The thickness of CGI sheet is
explain: CGI sheets are manufactured in various gauges giving a thickness range of approximately 0.13 mm to 4 mm depending on gauge number.

q: 3. The trap which is provided to disconnect the house drain from the street sewer is called
explain: The master trap (also called an intercepting trap at the point of connection) is installed to disconnect/seal the house drainage system from the street/public sewer, preventing foul gases from entering the house.

q: 4. The inspection pit or chamber is a manhole provided in a base drainage system
explain: Inspection chambers/manholes are provided at every change of direction, every change of gradient, and at regular (about 30 m) intervals along straight runs, to allow access for cleaning and inspection.

q: 5. In specification of earth work in foundation trenches, drains, etc lift ordinarily specified is
explain: The standard 'lift' (vertical height through which excavated earth is thrown out) specified for foundation trench excavation is 1.5 m; beyond this, extra lift charges apply.

q: 6. Filling work in trenches shall be carried out in layers of thickness not more than
explain: Backfilling in trenches is done in layers not exceeding 300 mm thickness, so each layer can be properly compacted before the next is placed.

q: 7. Anti-siphonage pipe is connected to
explain: The anti-siphonage pipe is connected to the top of the P-trap of the water closet to maintain the water seal by preventing siphonic loss of trap water.

q: 8. The portion which is wrongly excavated by the contractor is to be filled by
options: the earth excavated from the same pit
the earth excavated from the same pit far away from the site
explain: Any over-excavation done in error by the contractor must be made good using concrete (as specified for the foundation), not loose earth, to maintain bearing capacity, and at the contractor's own cost.

q: 9. What is the minimum period for which the lime concrete in foundation be left wet without the construction of masonry over it?
explain: Lime concrete in a foundation must be kept wet (cured) for a minimum of 7 days before any masonry construction is started over it, to allow proper setting.

q: 10. The main purpose of specification is
explain: Specifications serve to define work nature, material quality, and assist in accurate costing and quantity surveying.

q: 11. *Which one information is not found in specification?
explain: While specifications describe quality and method, dimensions are primarily found in architectural and engineering drawings, not the written specification.

q: 12. In specification of earth work in foundation trenches, drains etc. lead specified is (IS code)
explain: The standard unit of horizontal distance (lead) for disposal of earth is 30 meters according to IS codes.

q: 13. *The number of standard modular bricks required to make 1 m3 of masonry (as per IS Code) is
explain: When accounting for mortar joints, exactly 500 standard modular bricks are required per cubic meter of masonry.

q: 14. In a galvanized corrugated iron sheet the pitch (centre to centre distance) of corrugation is usually
explain: Standard G.I. corrugated sheets have a corrugation pitch of about 75 mm center-to-center.

q: 15. The thickness of 25 gauge sheet is
explain: In standard wire/sheet gauge (SWG) tables, a 25-gauge sheet corresponds to a thickness of less than 1 mm.

q: 16. When it is not specified, the number of hold fasts for a door frame is usually taken as
explain: A standard door frame requires 6 hold-fasts (3 on each side) to secure it into the masonry.

q: 17. The minimum number of hinges provided in door and window shutter should be
explain: Doors generally require 3 hinges for stability, while windows typically require 2.

q: 18. The standard width of galvanized iron sheet is
explain: The standard commercial width for GI sheets is 36 inches.

q: 19. End lap provided in asbestos cements is equal to
explain: The vertical overlap (end lap) between AC sheets should be 15 cm.

q: 20. The minimum space left from property line (In Kathmandu valley) for the provision of window/door is
explain: Building bylaws in Kathmandu Valley require a 5-foot setback from the property line if windows or doors are to be installed.

q: 21. The thickness of 25 guage sheet is
explain: 25 Gauge (SWG) steel is approximately 0.508 mm thick, which is significantly less than 1mm.

q: 22. Dismental means
options: breaking up the structure with care
explain: Dismantling implies taking a structure apart carefully so that the components can be salvaged and reused.

q: 23. Specifications for the hold fasts are given in terms of
explain: Hold fasts are specified in terms of their length (e.g., 30 cm, 40 cm hold fast), which determines their embedment and anchoring capacity.

q: 24. Quality of works or materials is mentioned in
explain: Specifications are the document where the required quality of works and materials for each item is explicitly described.

q: 25. In a galvanised corrugated iron sheet the pitch (centre to centre distance) of corrugation is usually
explain: The centre-to-centre distance (pitch) between corrugations in a standard GCI sheet is usually about 75 mm.

q: 26. Which one of the following is not the standard length of asbestos cement corrugated sheets
explain: Standard AC corrugated sheet lengths are available in specific increments (such as 1.5, 1.75, 1.25 m and others); 2.5 m is not among the standard manufactured lengths.

q: 27. The inspection pit or chamber is a manhole provided in a base drainage system
options: at every change of direction and gradient
at the point where vertical soil pipe joins the house drain
explain: Inspection chambers/manholes are provided at every change of direction/gradient, at regular 30 m intervals, and where a vertical soil pipe meets the house drain — all these conditions apply.

q: 28. Specification for the holdfasts are given in terms of
explain: Holdfasts (metal anchors for door/window frames) are specified in terms of their weight, since they are fabricated steel items.

q: 29. The two type of specification commonly are
explain: Specifications usually focus on the materials to be used and the items of work to be performed.

q: 30. The size of the standard modular brick is
explain: The standard modular brick size (as per IS specifications) is 19 cm × 9 cm × 9 cm, which becomes 20 × 10 × 10 cm when a 1 cm mortar joint is included.
